text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet! Undisputed, the absolute 
pinnacle of her generation!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I did it, I did it, I actually pulled it 
off...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: 'Cause I'm number one!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ngh, ahhh! Dammit!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Fine, whatever! I'll let you have it for 
today!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
B-But! The strongest is me! Next time, 
I'll definitely prove it...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoooooa!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph, not bad.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Next time, and the time after that, number 
one is gonna be ME! I'm never gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka really are amazing 
together...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean. No matter which of 
them wins, it makes you look forward to 
what comes next!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Haa, haa.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "It's frustrating. I couldn't reach it."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...My resolve has hardened.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It is my determination to achieve even 
greater success moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It was Machan who chose the sprint 
division. I have no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Still, as expected, Vodka and Scarlet are 
formidable.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Just having those two clash against each 
other causes expectations for the race to 
skyrocket.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Then deeper and stronger than ever 
before. I have to leave my mark, the Aston 
Machan way."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...For now, it's the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

With that, Aston Machan suddenly began 
walking in the opposite direction of the 
inn we'd booked. I hurry to stop her.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We are in Kyoto in the autumn. We simply 
must take a commemorative photo with the 
autumn leaves.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Are you coming too, Trainer?

Afterward, I enjoyed the crimson-tinted 
streets of Kyoto together with Aston 
Machan.
